# Episciences

## Documentation Sets

- [Abridged documentation](https://doc.episciences.org/llms-small.txt): a compact version of the documentation for Episciences, with non-essential content removed
- [Complete documentation](https://doc.episciences.org/llms-full.txt): the full documentation for Episciences
- [English Documentation](https://doc.episciences.org/_llms-txt/english-documentation.txt): Complete documentation for Episciences platform in English
- [Documentation en français](https://doc.episciences.org/_llms-txt/documentation-en-fran%C3%A7ais.txt): Documentation complète de la plateforme Episciences en français

## Notes

- The complete documentation includes all content from the official documentation
- The content is automatically generated from the same source as the official documentation
